definition.quantity: Amortized agent review elapsed per supported eligible listing
definition.population: Exact 100 frozen native IDs from the 549-repository retained seed cohort.
definition.boundary: Private Codex review. Admission-ready means useful purpose, supported health-tech relevance, source-backed dated regional connection and original link. Public catalog admission is a separate event.
exclusions: Exclude setup, independent code review, code fixes, tests and CI waits from the time numerator.
Retain rejected, held, forked, archived and poorly described leads in the 100-lead denominator.
definition.window: One completed review of the frozen 100 leads on 17 November 2026; use recorded monotonic session endpoints and UTC timestamps.
definition.sampling: Existing GL08-yield-20261117-v1 SHA-256 selection, with no replacements or metadata filters.
conditions: All 100 native IDs receive one final eligible/rejected/held decision.

Eligibility requires all four lean criteria. Unknown evidence remains held; a dated historical creator or institutional association may qualify without a claim of current employment or project worksite.
No paper, biography or non-fork requirement is added.
If eligible count is zero, minutes per eligible listing is undefined and reported null.
Use non-overlapping monotonic-clock batch sessions; do not invent per-lead times from averages.
A metadata-only inventory display occurred during setup before timed decisions; setup time is excluded and disclosed.
definition.uncertainty: Conditional descriptive cohort result. Seed-account selection, incomplete inventories, accepted-response filtering, account clustering and source availability limit generalization. Agent elapsed time does not estimate human maintenance capacity, public publication cost, regional yield/recall or clinical validity.

reviewMinutes.quantity: Sum of timed review session elapsed minutes, including source-read latency and rejected/held cases

eligible.quantity: Eligible sampled listings with a prepared lean listing

aggregation.basis: Sum review time over all 100 leads before dividing by eligible, admission-ready listing count.

AcceptedPlan.locator: docs/discovery/go-live/README.md minimum useful listing; plan.json execution_sequence step 2
AcceptedPlan.basis: Accepted lean rule and current user instruction to review this frozen sample and record eligible fraction and minutes per admission.

FrozenSample.basis: Original immutable selection before labels or timing.
